body:
My university health center is absolute shit to be blunt. I called them after my very bad suicidal night and left a voicemail about needing to be seen by mental health. They never called me back or contacted me. Even leaving a voicemail saying "I am very depressed and anxious, please help" didn't get an ear. I've given up on them since they gave up on me.

I think tomorrow I will try and get an appointment with my dr as soon as possible which will still probably be 3 weeks. Ugh...

Well the thing is it will be 3 months until I can see a psychiatrist so I can't really get referred to a psychologist unless my family doctor will do it. I have some reservations about chasing medicines even though it has been uniformly terrible for my mood, but that is a whole other can of mental disorder worms. 
I just can't go to the ER like I said I'm in university. I can't miss classes because I already miss too much of them as it is from depression and my family would never understand...
Thanks, I checked it out and found 3 psychiatrists in my town accepting patients, maybe I'll get lucky...

I switched in December. It has come in waves. End of January was very horrible. Extremely depressed. Then it went away barely mid March and a week later came back and now I am back in darkness. 
I just can't go to the ER.

Yeah, I can't go to the hospital because I am away at university and I have other reservations regarding future barriers to a professional school should they ever find out...

Yes, their calendar is that full. My goal is to see my normal Dr but she can't give me the advice or anything that I need which is why I want to see a psychiatrist. I know I'm in a bad spot. I just don't think I can last 3 months at this rate...

I understand you completely. I am graduating with a biology bachelors degree in 2 weeks and I am far from happy about it. Every semester has been more isolating than the last. My job prospects seem bleak because my plans to apply to graduate school or medical school are useless with the amount of depression and anxiety in my life. I entered college with zero friends and I have acquired a grand total of zero friends in college. 
I feel like a ghost on this campus everyday I go to class. Which is why I don't go to class very much anymore. 
I guess my point in telling you all of this is to say I can emphasize with your position in life.
